text:
Kevin Liu: Kicking off follow-up from last night's authZ incident. Postmortem is up: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBf-postmortem (summary below). Primary goals: close remediation tasks, add automated detection for the recurring pattern, and lock down secrets rotation timeline.

Maria Gomez: Thanks — I can own audit logging gaps. Will validate that all services emit request_id + principal for grant/deny paths.

Alex Farrow: I will take token validation test coverage + CI gate. Plan: add unit tests for `exp`/`iat`/`aud` checks and a small integration job in staging.

Diana Park: I'll own the secrets rotation automation. Draft runbook + terraform for scheduled rotations.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-034 created and linked to this thread. SLA: recovery acknowledged 2026-03-22T23:14Z.

Kevin Liu: Action item list (assignments + dates) — let's treat these as sprint work items, not long tails.

AI-1 | Token validation CI gate | owner: Alex Farrow | due: 2026-04-02 | status: todo
- Add tests for edge-cases: missing `iat`, large `nbf` skews, replay attempts.
- Add a quick smoke in pre-production pipeline: `./tools/run_authz_smoke.sh --staging`

AI-2 | Audit logging coverage | owner: Maria Gomez | due: 2026-04-05 | status: in progress
- Gap: authz DENY paths currently omit `principal_type` in service-xyz.
- Query to validate logs (example):
```
resource.type="k8s_container" AND jsonPayload.event="authz_check" AND jsonPayload.outcome!="allow"
```
- Deliverable: dashboard + monthly export to retention store.

AI-3 | Reroute fallback policy review | owner: Kevin Liu | due: 2026-03-30 | status: todo
- Ensure fallback to read-only model variants preserves least privilege.
- Add a runtime feature flag to toggle aggressive fallbacks.

AI-4 | Secrets rotation automation + runbook | owner: Diana Park | due: 2026-04-09 | status: todo
- Automate rotation for service tokens older than 180 days.
- Create `rotation-runbook.md` and a daily verification job: `scripts/verify_rotations.py --last-rotated <90d`

AI-5 | Detection alert for recurring pattern | owner: Maria Gomez + SRE | due: 2026-04-01 | status: todo
- Pattern observed: 3 incidents in last 60 days where token validation missed `aud` check or audit logs absent.
- Proposed alert: `authz.invalid_token_rate > 0.3% for 10m` -> Pager to sec-oncall.
- Example log-based metric rule: `metric(authz.invalid_token) by service`

Alex Farrow: For AI-1, I'll open a PR with tests by EOD Friday and add the CI job to `redwood-ci` as a new pipeline step.

Maria Gomez: For AI-2 I'm starting an audit sweep tomorrow. Will post results here and the dashboard link. Also recommending we add a schema-level enforcement for audit fields.

Diana Park: For AI-4 I'll prototype the rotation TF module and put a PoC PR into infra-private. Need help from infra to add KMS permissions.

Kevin Liu: Recurrence and long-term changes — proposal:
- Weekly 30m remediation sync (Mon 9am PT) for 6 weeks.
- Add a Trello/Jira epic `SEC-ROTATIONS-2026` and move AI items under it.
- Quarterly audit (automated) to detect missing fields and expired tokens.

security-bot: Reminder scheduled: Weekly remediation sync added to calendar (Mon 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC).

Diana Park: Quick note on verification: after rotation automation, we'll run `gcloud logging read` and a smoke that replays 100 random recent tokens against staging validator.

Kevin Liu: OK — I'll act as coordinator. I'll update the postmortem doc with the AI table and mark owners. Please add brief daily updates in this thread (1-2 lines). I'll close the thread when all AI items are moved to Jira and first PRs are merged. :white_check_mark:

Alex Farrow: Added initial checklist to PR #4821 (WIP).

Maria Gomez: Audit sweep results: found 6 services missing `principal_type`. Filing small follow-ups and assigning to owners.

Kevin Liu: Great. Next checkpoint: 2026-03-30 sync. If anything blocks, ping me and @diana.

security-bot: Action items AI-1..AI-5 recorded to INC-2026-034.
